In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the remnants of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched a multi-pronged '''campaign''' on the orders of the reborn [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The campaign, which soon dissolved into the [[Imperial Civil War|Imperial Mutiny]], was followed by [[Operation Shadow Hand]].

==Prelude==
In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], both the Galactic Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] thought Emperor Palpatine dead in the destruction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Second Death Star]]. In fact, his spirit had survived and made its way to the Imperial redoubt of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], where it spent a lengthy convalescence as it was reborn into a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body. In the mean time, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] advanced from Endor, slowly chipping away at a Galactic Empire that was torn by [[Warlord/Legends|warlordism]], until by [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] it had captured [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

Prior to the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Palpatine's clone slowly drew military forces into the Deep Core for a new offensive: Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Feyet Kiez]] abandoned [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] with the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Whelm]]'' at Palpatine's orders, leaving even his second-in-command [[Osted Wermis]] none the wiser about his destination. The Imperial warlord-turned-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Inos Fonada]] disappeared down the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] with his fleet; the top designers of an Imperial research facility on [[Kelada/Legends|Kelada]] vanished with all their weapons schematics; and after the [[Taking of Kuat|seizure of Kuat]], the entire senior [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] design team fled into the Deep Core aboard the half-completed [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|dreadnought]] [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']].<ref name="TEGTW" />

The New Republic mostly forgot about these reports during the near-disaster of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] final campaign, and in its aftermath, reasserted its power with raids into the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]], conquering the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council's]] capital of [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]] and striking at the self-styled [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]]'s [[Ciutric Hegemony]] in the [[Hegemony theater]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> Krennel was chosen due to his murder of [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] several years earlier, and had continued to support his reign by bloody purges and repressing non-humans. The choice was seen as controversial by many, as Krennel had been relatively quiet since his rise to power and had not attempted to move outside the Hegemony. Aided by [[Ysanne Isard (clone)|Ysanne Isard's clone]], Krennel had helped this image by speaking out against [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]], apologizing for the destruction of Alderaan, admitting the Empire had committed many wrong acts, and offering a refuge to Humans displaced by the New Republic's policies of reversing Imperial [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]]. As the policy continued, they were approached or had been approached by a number of refugee groups and other former Imperials, including [[Alderaanian refugee]]s. They also had sent word to Gilad Pellaeon about bringing Thrawn's fleet into the Hegemony. However, the tide began to turn against them after the discovery of the plans for the [[Pulsar Station]], a Death Star-like superweapon. In reality, the plans were false and had been planted by the real [[Ysanne Isard]], who helped a New Republic force led by Rogue Squadron liberate the Hegemony and kill Krennel.

Meanwhile, Palpatine's agents made overtures to the Deep Core warlords, [[Blitzer Harrsk]] of [[Zero Command]], [[Treuten Teradoc]], and [[Sander Delvardus]]. The remnants of the Loyalist [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] accepted the reborn Emperor as well, as did the otherwise-isolationist [[Pentastar Alignment]] led by [[Ardus Kaine]]. Most of the factions in Palpatine's alliance hated each other, but all feared both the Emperor's wrath and missing out on the cut of the spoils of a successful campaign.<ref name="TEA" />

==The campaign==
===Advance from the Deep Core===
[[File:Palpatine_Clone_EGTF.jpg|thumb|110px|Reborn Palpatine]]
With [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] far out in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] pursuing Krennel, the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] were left lightly defended, and Palpatine chose this moment to strike. Three enormous Imperial task forces advanced out of the Deep Core, anchored around four [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class dreadnoughts]] (including the missing ''[[Whelm]]''), five [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator'' III-class dreadnoughts]], and three [[Vengeance-class dreadnought|''Vengeance''-class dreadnoughts]]. The New Republic Navy, so long optimised for smaller [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]-launched [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighter]] action, proved to have no counter to the massive [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> The Deep Core fleets [[Battle of Kaikielius (Galactic Civil War)|conquered Kaikielius]] and [[Battle of Alsakan (Galactic Civil War)|Alsakan]]. Meanwhile, [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] [[Battle of Corellia (10 ABY)|struck Corellia.]]<ref name="TEGTW" /><ref name="TEA" />

The New Republic cobbled together a hasty defense at [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]], but its fleets were caught completely out of position. Fleets sent from [[Imperial Space]] in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] descended on the Core from the north, [[Battle of Anaxes (10 ABY)|conquering Anaxes]] and [[Battle of Borleias (10 ABY)|Borleias]]. Meanwhile, [[Sander Delvardus]] [[Battle of Metellos (Galactic Civil War)|annihilated the fleet at Metellos]], and the Ruling Council's forces advanced across the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Borderland Regions]], capturing [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] and [[Columex/Legends|Columex]].<ref name="TEGTW" /><ref name="TEA" />

===The fall of Coruscant===
{{Main|Second Battle of Coruscant}}
Imperial fleets converged on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and initiated a savage bombardment of the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]]. With no hope of victory, [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] ordered an evacuation of the planet, carried out by [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]. The New Republic resorted to guerrilla fighting amid [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> but ultimately lost the battle, and General [[Alix Balan]] led an Imperial triumph through the boulevards of Coruscant.<ref name="TEGTW" /><ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
{{Main|Imperial Civil War}}
The New Republic's government regrouped on [[Da Soocha V]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. They regarded the Empire's rapid new advance as unsustainable and awaited the opportunity to launch counterattacks. The newly-unified Empire, however, soon collapsed into a horrific six-way civil war between the Ruling Council, the Moffs, the Fleet commanders, the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]], and the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] that became known as the [[Imperial Civil War|Imperial Mutiny]]. Coruscant was left a depopulated ruin. The cloned Emperor Palpatine did nothing to quell this fratricide, viewing it as "culling the weak", and instead used the opportunity to publicly reveal himself and [[Battle of Calamari|deploy]] his [[World Devastator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] as part of [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="TEGTW" /><ref name="TEA" />

The New Republic's poor performance against Imperial [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnoughts]] inspired the development of their own dreadnought analogues, the [[Mediator-class battle cruiser|''Mediator''-class battle cruiser]] and the [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class Star Defender]] as part of the [[New Class Modernization Program]] in the aftermath of [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
